mapper.select: SELECT o.status AS status, COUNT(1) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0 GROUP BY o.status

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 20 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paidAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status IN (0, 10) THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpaidAmount, 0 AS overdueAmount FROM ad_payment p WHERE p.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(o.create_time / 1000, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(1) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND FROM_UNIXTIME(o.create_time / 1000, '%Y') = #{year} GROUP BY FROM_UNIXTIME(o.create_time / 1000, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 0) AS draftCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 10) AS pendingApproveOrder, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 45) AS pendingExecute, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_order_change c WHERE c.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 10) AS changePending, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_order_change c WHERE c.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 20) AS changeExecute, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_receipt r WHERE r.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0) AS receiptDraft, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_receipt r WHERE r.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 10) AS receiptApprove, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_payment p WHERE p.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 0) AS payoutDraft, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_payment p WHERE p.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 10) AS payoutApprove, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_contract c WHERE c.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.seal_status = 0) AS sealApply, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_seal_record s WHERE s.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status = 0) AS sealApprove, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_contract c WHERE c.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.seal_status = 20) AS archiveSubmit, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_contract c WHERE c.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.seal_status = 40) AS archiveApprove, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status NOT IN (90, 100) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ad_order_contract oc WHERE oc.order_id = o.id AND oc.deleted = 0)) AS missingContract

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(o.receivable_amount), 0) AS receivableAmount, IFNULL(SUM(o.media_payable_amount), 0) AS mediaPayableAmount FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(o.received_amount), 0) AS receivedAmount, IFNULL(SUM(o.invoiced_amount), 0) AS invoicedAmount FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(o.media_paid_amount), 0) AS mediaPaidAmount FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0

SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.order_name AS orderName, o.business_entity_id AS businessEntityId, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status NOT IN (90, 100) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ad_order_contract oc WHERE oc.order_id = o.id AND oc.deleted = 0) ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status NOT IN (90, 100)) AS activeOrderCount, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(o.receivable_amount) FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status != 100), 0) AS totalReceivable, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(o.media_payable_amount) FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status != 100), 0) AS totalMediaPayable, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(o.receivable_amount - o.received_amount) FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status != 100 AND o.receipt_done = 0), 0) AS pendingReceivable, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(o.media_payable_amount - o.media_paid_amount) FROM ad_order o WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status != 100 AND o.payment_done = 0), 0) AS pendingPayable
SELECT s.status AS status, COUNT(1) AS count FROM ad_seal_record s WHERE s.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.status
